events.verdict: Tucker (HOU) cleanly deflects the pass to Ibaka (TOR).
Rivers (HOU) turns his body into Siakam (TOR) and makes contact with his body and affects his shot attempt.
Siakam (TOR) moves laterally into the path of Rivers (HOU) at the start of the drive but the contact is marginal and does not affect SQBR.
Rivers (HOU) splits his feet before dribbling.
Lowry (TOR) makes marginal contact with Harden's (HOU) body and does not affect his shot attempt.
Siakam (TOR) drives to the basket and does not drive through Faried (HOU) when he releases the pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Ibaka (TOR) is in the lane for longer than three seconds.
Green (TOR) moves into Gordon (HOU) and makes contact that affects his SQBR.
Leonard (TOR) and Tucker (HOU) briefly engage and separate in the post.
Ibaka (TOR) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Powell (TOR) sets the screen on Tucker (HOU) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Leonard (TOR) maintains a legal guarding position and cleanly steals the ball from Harden (HOU).
Siakam (TOR) has his arm rested on Faried's (HOU) back, but does not extend it into him to deliver contact while going for the rebound.
Harden (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on Powell (TOR) during the drive.
Lowry (TOR) grabs Gordon's (HOU) arm prior to his gather and shooting motion.
Powell (HOU) sets the screen on Tucker (HOU) and does not deliver contact.
Harden (HOU) makes marginal contact with Leonard (TOR) during his shooting motion that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
